comment: Image matrix read by .github/workflows/images.yml with jq (R0.3). Each entry is an object {name, dockerfile, context}; the build job runs once per entry for linux/amd64 and linux/arm64 and pushes to ghcr.io on v* tags only. solver-query is the first entry (S06); api, library-builder and web follow the same shape with their own Dockerfile under infra/docker when their sessions publish them. scripts/images-matrix.test.mjs checks every entry. With an empty list the workflow prints a notice and skips the build job.
